narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Sixty two is even, so the board can be tiled!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>An even count is needed, but we saw it is not always enough.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>We must also count the two colours.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, count each colour after the squares are removed.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>If the two counts are not equal, no tiling with these tiles can exist.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines: count the colours after removing; they must be equal for a tiling
